   **People:** Haodong Lu and Dong Gong. **Affiliation:** Artificer AI Lab, University of New South Wales, Sydney.

query: multi-turn reinforcement learning user simulation benchmarks
text:
1. **[LMRL Gym: Benchmarks for Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning with Language Models](https://lmrl-gym.github.io/)** — Eight dialogue and text-game tasks, with simulated conversational partners, online environments, and offline training datasets. **People:** Marwa Abdulhai, Isadora White, Charlie Snell, Charles Sun, Joey Hong, and Yuexiang Zhai (UC Berkeley); Kelvin Xu (Google DeepMind); Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley and Google DeepMind).

2. **[UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.19736v1)** — Training and evaluation environments pairing agents with simulated users, covering persuasion, intent discovery, search, and tool use. **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), and collaborators including Zuxin Liu, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).

3. **[τ²-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07982)** — A benchmark where both agents and simulated users can act on a shared environment, testing communication and coordination. **People:** Victor Barres, Soham Ray, and Karthik Narasimhan (Sierra); Honghua Dong (Sierra, University of Toronto, and Vector Institute); Xujie Si (University of Toronto and Vector Institute).

query: editable training systems for tool-using agents
text:
The closest matches span customizable agent training and systems that improve editable prompts or workflows:

1. **Agent Lightning — Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning.** Separates agent execution from training, supporting existing tool-using agents with minimal code changes. **People:** Xufang Luo, Yuge Zhang, Zhiyuan He, Zilong Wang, Dongsheng Li, Luna K. Qiu, and Yuqing Yang — Microsoft Research Asia, Shanghai. [Project overview](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/agent-lightning-adding-reinforcement-learning-to-ai-agents-without-code-rewrites/).

2. **DSPy — Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines.** Builds editable, modular agent programs and optimizes their prompts, examples, or model weights against a metric. **People:** Omar Khattab — Stanford/Databricks; Christopher Potts — Stanford; Matei Zaharia — UC Berkeley/Databricks; Heather Miller — CMU/Two Sigma, with a broader contributor team. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.03714) · [Team and affiliations](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/main/docs/docs/roadmap.md).

3. **TextGrad — Automatic “Differentiation” via Text.** Uses natural-language feedback to optimize editable components of compound AI systems. Relevant to prompt and workflow improvement, although broader than tool-using agent training. **People:** Mert Yuksekgonul, Federico Bianchi, Joseph Boen, Sheng Liu, Zhi Huang, Carlos Guestrin, and James Zou — Stanford University. [Project and team](https://textgrad.com/).

4. **ThinkingBox — Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows.** Defines tools as MCP servers and supports training-data generation, reinforcement-learning loops, and evaluation. **People:** Zhuochun Li, Youngmin Ko, Ali Keramati, Nicola Ferri, and collaborators; the repository identifies its origins with the Microsoft Copilot Studio agentic reinforcement-learning team. [Repository and paper citation](https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox).

text:
1. **[UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning](https://lifelongagent.github.io/Project-Lifelong-Agent/UserRL/index.html)** — Trains agents through simulated user interactions, standardized environments, and reward shaping. **People:** Cheng Qian and Heng Ji — University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang — Salesforce AI Research.
